verdict.rationale: Clara is a corporate card and spend management platform, so mileage logging and per-diem claims are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack has no mention of mileage tracking, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. The only related item is a generic claim of 'automated expense reporting', which does not show this capability.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
